requirements.title: CEILING arguments are real A and optional scalar integer constant KIND
requirements.definition: A shall be of type real and KIND, if present, shall be a scalar integer constant expression.

pending.A-real-argument: Source-control plan: use conforming references CEILING(3.25) and CEILING(-3.25); a wrong-type argument is an unnumbered intrinsic argument restriction and carries no diagnostic fixture here.
pending.KIND-scalar-integer-constant-expression: Use integer, parameter :: k = selected_int_kind(9); 7.4.3.1 requires support for an integer decimal exponent range of at least 18, so k is a valid nonnegative kind. A positive source/control reference CEILING(3.25,KIND=k) checks KIND(result) == k and exact value 4_k; nonscalar or nonconstant KIND remains an unnumbered argument restriction with no diagnostic facet here.

requirements.title: CEILING returns an integer of the selected or default kind
requirements.definition: The result is integer; present KIND selects the result kind type parameter, and absent KIND selects default integer kind.

pending.result-integer-type: Future fixture assigns CEILING(3.25) to an integer sentinel target and checks an exact integer value, proving the integer result without relying on real output formatting.
pending.present-KIND-selects-result-kind: Let integer, parameter :: k = selected_int_kind(9), which is valid because 7.4.3.1 requires support for range at least 18. Evaluate CEILING(3.25,KIND=k), expect KIND(result) == k and value 4_k; mutate by omitting KIND or changing the expected kind in the fixture source/oracle.
pending.absent-KIND-default-integer-kind: Evaluate KIND(CEILING(-3.25)) and expect KIND(0); a fixture mutation changes the expected kind or adds an explicit selected kind in a separate present-KIND case rather than relying on processor kind distinctness.

requirements.title: CEILING returns the least integer greater than or equal to A
requirements.definition: The result value is the least integer greater than or equal to A.

pending.least-integer-greater-or-equal-value: Use exact real inputs 3.25, -3.25, and 4.0; expect CEILING values 4, -3, and 4. Mutate to FLOOR/NINT or change a sign so the exact integer checks fail.
